author: screen-tutor-lab
title: Candidate video-to-spreadsheet concept transfer

objectives.text: Explain why each source row contributes to exactly one grouped total.
Locate the current application's grouping control and verify a safe grouped result.

route_claims: Select the current application's grouping control using current semantic evidence.
Choose the intended label field and aggregate every integer amount exactly once.
Verify the resulting groups against the source rows before recording an independent outcome.
